messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: prod-gpu-01 cluster experiencing rapid GPU queue growth; autoscaler failing to add nodes. Paging oncall.
alex: grabbing console. inference-queue backlog spiking, long-gen requests timing out. starting triage now.
alex: cluster-autoscaler logs show repeated failures creating launch template versions: \"AccessDenied: iam:PassRole\" when attempting to provision. looks like an instance profile change rolled out recently.
sam: alert summary: GPU utilization 96-99%, queue +480 items in 12m, 5xx rate up to 3.2%, elevated p95 latency. customer impact: some streaming responses dropped/errored, batch jobs delayed.
alex: tails from autoscaler logs:

```
I0310 11:58:20 autoscaler.go:212] scaleUp: nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 current=8 target=12
E0310 11:58:21 aws_cloud_provider.go:402] createLaunchTemplateVersion failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole
E0310 11:58:21 aws_cloud_provider.go:754] provisioning aborted for nodegroup-prod-gpu-2
```

alex: CloudTrail confirms CreateLaunchTemplateVersion and RunInstances calls denied for the autoscaler role at 11:58:21.
maria: infra-iam, any recent LT or instance-profile changes overnight? @jin
jin: pushed LT v5 for kernel/driver fixes last night; LT v4 existed earlier. v5's instance profile is `prod-gpu-ec2-role-v5` — looking at its attached policy, it lacks the iam:PassRole permission for the node provisioning flow.
elaine: that was part of a kernel rollout; infra pipeline updated the instance profile but the trust/policy check in the PR missed passrole. rolling forward created a gap.
ops-bot: Created internal ticket #INFRA-5792 and notified infra-iam.
sam: mitigation options (quickest to slowest):
- revert ASG launch template to a known-good version (v4) and scale desired to relieve queue
- add iam:PassRole to autoscaler role (needs infra approval)
- drain low-priority batch pods to free GPUs (service impact for non-critical jobs)

alex: I'll perform ASG quick-fix: set launch template version to v4 and bump desired capacity by +3 to get throughput back.

```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=4 --desired-capacity 11
```

alex: ASG update accepted. new instances launching with v4 profile. watching node join events.

(4m later)

alex: nodes registered, pods scheduled, queue length declining. provisioned +3 GPUs.
sam: putting a short platform status message if error rate remains >2% for another 10m. notifying CS for customers on affected clusters.
maria: infra-iam reports they will patch `prod-gpu-ec2-role-v5` with required passrole and add missing policy; ETA ~20-30m for validation and small rollout.
jin: note: cluster-autoscaler still attempted to use LT v5 in some code paths (it creates launch template versions, often the latest). need to teach it to fall back or respect explicit LT version in nodegroup config.
alex: temporary autoscaler stabilization steps: annotated autoscaler to prefer nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 and disabled immediate scale-down for 15m so we don't oscillate while infra fixes role.

```
kubectl -n kube-system annotate deployment/cluster-autoscaler ops/prefer-nodegroup=nodegroup-prod-gpu-2
kubectl -n kube-system set env deployment/cluster-autoscaler CA_DISABLE_SCALE_DOWN=true
```

sam: after the ASG fix, error rate dropped from 3.2% to 1.6%, median latency back to normal but p95 still elevated. queue max was +510.

(25m later)

maria: infra-iam patched `prod-gpu-ec2-role-v5` to include iam:PassRole and updated instance profile. ran a small test rollout; provisioning with v5 no longer triggers AccessDenied.
alex: reverting ASG manual override to allow autoscaler control (but keeping annotation for stability). setting desired back down:

```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 --desired-capacity 8
```

alex: autoscaler retried provisioning with v5; no AccessDenied now, nodes came up.
sam: customer-impact summary for postmortem: brief tail-latency spikes (1-5 minutes) causing retries on streaming endpoints, background batch jobs delayed up to ~30 minutes; no data loss or persistent failures reported.
jin: recommended follow-ups:
- implement preflight IAM validation for LT/instance-profile changes in the infra rollout pipeline
- make cluster-autoscaler fallback to last-known-good LT version if new LT provisioning fails repeatedly
- create an alert on repeated iam:PassRole errors in autoscaler logs
- document manual ASG rollback runbook (commands used here)
elaine: I'll add a pipeline gate to check instance profile permissions for passrole before merging LT changes.
maria: oncall handoff in ~30m. alex, can you write up handoff notes including state, actions, and owners?
alex: handoff notes:
- incident start (thread_ts): 2026-03-10T11:58:20Z
- root symptom: GPU queue growth due to autoscaler unable to provision nodes (AccessDenied iam:PassRole on new launch template instance profile)
- immediate mitigation: updated ASG to use LT v4 and increased desired capacity (+3); annotated autoscaler to prevent scale-down while stabilizing; infra patched v5 instance profile; reverted ASG to autoscaler control
- current state: metrics stable, queue drained, no further AccessDenied events
- customer impact: short-lived tail-latency spikes, ~3% peak 5xx, batch delays up to 30m; CS notified
- followups: infra pipeline gate, autoscaler LT fallback behavior, IAM validation job, alert on repeated passrole errors, add manual rollback runbook
- owners: infra-iam (policy + pipeline), eng-sre (autoscaler changes + alerts), platform (runbook)

maria: taking the handoff. will continue to monitor for next 60m and then close the paging if green.
sam: CS update sent; customers informed of mitigations and expected resolution window. ops-bot: recording incident #INFRA-5792, assigning postmortem owners.

(1h later)

maria: final: metrics stable for 45m, no recurrence. closing paging. will open a postmortem doc with timeline and action items.

sam: thanks team. :thumbsup:
